profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Circle | Stanford Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern at VMware
positions.description:
- Software Engineering Intern at VMware on Workspace One Access Team
- Develops a Spring for Apache Kafka producer, consumer and application in Java
- Improved products ability reliably to receive messages by 900%
- Works with technologies such as Docker, RabbitMQ, Jira, Maven, and
Jenkins

positions.title: CS106A Head Teachers Assistant
positions.description:
- Head TA for Programming Methodologies, one of the largest undergraduate classes at Stanford 
        with typical enrollments of over 500 students
- Manages a staff of undergraduate section leaders and TAs
- Prepares course materials and help decide on course direction
- Gives guest lectures and hold office hours
